testler.soru: TEST 1: If the base plate dislodges when the mouth is half-open
testler.icerik:
Problem: Effect of the buccinator muscle.

Correction: At the level of the 1st and 2nd premolars, and 1st molar on both sides.

testler.soru: TEST 2: If the base plate dislodges when the mouth is opened widely as if yawning
testler.icerik:
Problem: Pterygomaxillary raphe and anterior fibers of the buccinator/masseter muscles.

Correction: Behind the tuberosities on both sides, at the level of the 2nd molars.

testler.soru: TEST 3: If the base plate dislodges during whistling or sucking movements
testler.icerik:
Problem: The labial vestibule and labial frenum area is overextended.

Correction: At the level of the labial frenum and labial vestibule area.

testler.soru: TEST 4: If it dislodges during backward/downward movement of the lip commissure while smiling
testler.icerik: Correction: At the level of the buccal frenum and buccal vestibule area.

testler.soru: TEST 5: If the base plate dislodges with the 'Ah' sound or coughing
testler.icerik: Correction: The base plate should be shortened in the anteroposterior direction.

testler.soru: TEST 1: If the base plate dislodges when the mouth is half-open
testler.icerik: Correction: Border extensions in the buccal vestibule area are shortened.

testler.soru: TEST 2: If the base plate dislodges when the mouth is opened widely
testler.icerik:
Problem: Pterygomaxillary raphe and anterior fibers of the masseter muscle.

Correction: The retromolar pad area to the level of the molars on both sides is shortened.

testler.soru: TEST 3: If the base plate dislodges when the tongue is protruded
testler.icerik:
Problem: Movements of the mylohyoid muscle.

Correction: The mylohyoid muscle should be relieved on the lingual side at the level of the molars; if necessary, the plate should be made concave.

testler.soru: TEST 4: If the plate dislodges when licking the inside of the cheek with the tip of the tongue
testler.icerik: Correction: Shortening is done at the level of the canines and premolars.

testler.soru: TEST 5: If the base plate dislodges when the tongue is directed towards the nose
testler.icerik:
Problem: The incisors and lingual frenum area on the lingual side.

Correction: Adjustments are made to these areas.

testler.soru: TEST 6: If there is a feeling of pain during swallowing
testler.icerik:
Problem: Superior constrictor muscle of the pharynx.

Correction: The distolingual corner of the plate should be shortened and polished.

testler.soru: TEST 7: If the plate dislodges during whistling/sucking movements
testler.icerik:
Problem: Contraction of the orbicularis oris muscle.

Correction: The labial frenum and anterior vestibular area are adjusted.
